title: Efficacy of the Buzzy System on Pain and Fear Reduction in Elbow Fracture Pin Removal
official: Efficacy of the Buzzy System on Pain and Fear Reduction in Elbow Fracture Pin Removal
summary: The goal of this study is to determine if the Buzzy System, a vibrating ice pack shaped like a bee reduces pain in removal of elbow fracture pin.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* between 3 to 10 years old
* undergoes percutaneous pinning of an elbow fracture

Exclusion Criteria:

* under age 3 or over age 10
* unable to quantify or express their pain
* Lack of parental consent
* Absence of caregiver during procedure
